Name: Em's Turtles
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
11 turtle options based on real turtles, including Marnie's adoption icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures﻿

The different types are:
Wood (dark brown and red)
Spotted (dark brown, red and yellow spots)
Blandings (green and yellow belly)
Box Green (green and yellow marks on body)
Box Spotted (green and yellow marks on body and shell)
Map Yellow (spiky shell and yellow stripes)
Map Brown (spiky shell and brown stripes)
Red-eared slider (green and red mark)
Hermann (yellow and brown)
Green (original Stardew colour)
Purple (original Stardew colour)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Turtles AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the scissors selected, left-click the turtle and choose its type
Enjoy!

Note: The adoption icon default is set to the two original colours. Any turtle bought at Marnie's shop gets a type assigned at random and can be changed with the scissors. For those who want to avoid the chance of getting the vanilla game texture when adopting a turtle, both the CP and AT versions can be installed side by side. This way, when you adopt a turtle, it will always be an Em's version!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]﻿

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Turtles CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default for both turtles is their original colour. To choose a different type:
Open ﻿the[i] config.json[/i] file in the Turtle mod folder
Replace the "﻿type" with the option you like
[color=#e69138]Turtle[/color] changes the [color=#e69138]green[/color] turtle
[color=#e69138]Turtle1[/color] changes the [color=#e69138]purple[/color] turtle
The choice you make also affects Marnie's adoption icon
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
